title: Distinct ad-copy variations
objective: Measure whether the ad-variations craftbook locks platform limits and produces genuinely distinct, complete ad variants instead of near-duplicate copy.
prompt: In the `Ad Variations Eval` project, write `ad-variations.json` for a Google search ad test for Harbor & Finch, a home-office accessories shop launching an ergonomic desk-lamp bundle. Use Google RSA-style limits: headlines <=30 characters and descriptions <=90 characters. Produce exactly 2 variants each for benefit-led, pain/problem-led, and social-proof angles. Include charCounts for every headline and description, and make each angle visibly distinct.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for ad-variations. The only deliverable is workspace/ad-variations.json.
setup.missionObjectives: Produce distinct, limit-aware ad variants for three named angles with complete fields and charCounts.

success.summary: ad-variations.json is valid JSON with named angles, complete ad fields, and character counts.
